aside.p: Write plain Bash. Each deployment action runs immediately before its required checks. Standalone checks run last. Each command starts in the remote SSH user's home directory. Exit 0 to pass, 1 for an issue, or 2 if the check cannot complete. Any nonzero exit stops later commands.
No placeholders or automatic backups, restarts, module upgrades, or Git checks are applied. Submitted requests retain their approved script.
